_comment: Example custom theme for kleeamp: noir-dawn. Copy this file, change the hex values, and import it from Settings — themes. Every role below is required; extras are ignored. The optional name is shown in Settings instead of custom. Colours are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Values marked derived are ground/ink blends in the style of the generated Omarchy themes, not colours the scheme ships.
name: noir dawn
